title: The Inspiring the Outstanding Scholarship
field: Master's programmes (eligible list published by KU Leuven)
about: KU Leuven invites applicants of all nationalities with previous degrees from outside Flanders to apply for The Inspiring the Outstanding Scholarship for an eligible master's programme starting in 2027-2028.
requirements: Complete application for an eligible KU Leuven master's programme
